clippings.speaker: J.J. Abrams
clippings.quote: I made him promise, when we were first doing the "Alias" pilot, that he would do everything that I ever did, and so he said he would. And so, though I didn't get it in writing, I plan to.
clippings.title: 'Lost,' 'Alias' Composer Michael Giacchino
clippings.context: Abrams in an NPR radio profile of Giacchino, then scoring both Alias and Lost.

clippings.speaker: Michael Giacchino
clippings.quote: I had never worked on a television series before, but the thing that I remember is that J.J. and I just got along instantly. You know, he loved everything that I loved as far as music goes and what that meant to movies and, in particular, what live music meant to movies and television.
clippings.title: 'Lost,' 'Alias' Composer Michael Giacchino
clippings.context: Giacchino recalling how Abrams hired him, a video game composer, for Alias.

clippings.speaker: J.J. Abrams
clippings.quote: He understands character and structure. So while it's wonderful to work with him as a composer, I give him the scripts in advance and get his comments and notes and show him cuts and scenes and rough cuts of the whole piece, just to get his reaction.
clippings.title: Michael Giacchino: Driven by stories
clippings.context: Abrams in a Variety profile of Giacchino on how early he brings the composer into a project.

clippings.speaker: J.J. Abrams
clippings.quote: Michael's music was the kind of music that I would find myself listening to in headphones when I was writing. And it just felt like clearly whoever was writing this music was as obsessed with the scores that I was familiar with growing up.
clippings.title: Michael Giacchino On Coming Home To Write Music For 'Jurassic World'
clippings.context: Abrams recalling discovering Giacchino through his Medal of Honor video game scores.

clippings.speaker: Michael Giacchino
clippings.quote: I was involved in Lost thanks to J. J. Abrams: I already worked with him for Alias . Besides our professional relationship, I have a special friendship with J. J., I really owe him a lot.
clippings.title: An interview with Michael Giacchino
clippings.context: Interview by Marco Bellano; Giacchino on how he came to score Lost (may be translated/edited from an Italian-conducted interview).

clippings.speaker: Michael Giacchino
clippings.quote: Well the great thing about working with J.J. is that he has a very good sense of getting a point across without hammering it over your head. … He has this really good sense of keeping things simple and I love that in his work, and it helps me as well, because I can be simple too.
clippings.title: A Conversation with Super 8 Composer Michael Giacchino
clippings.context: Giacchino discussing the home-movie scene in Super 8 and Abrams's restraint.

clippings.speaker: Michael Giacchino
clippings.quote: We both grew up making 8MM movies, Super 8, 16MM movies and as we got older we had a similar path just making films so there's this love of getting together with your friends and making something that we both shared. One of the reasons we get along very well is because we had that shared experiences growing up.
clippings.title: Exclusive: Interview…Film Composer Michael Giacchino
clippings.context: Giacchino, ahead of a Dallas Symphony concert, on meeting Abrams and scoring Super 8.
